dse_runs.notes: Area-critical sin/cos at >=1 MSPS, err <= 2^-10. Prefer small-LUT families (iterative / unrolled_k) with modest data widths; avoid large pipelined_m LUT multipliers. Selection rule: min luts_plus_ffs.

l3: not verified in this campaign: no recorded L3 row; a fresh exhaustive run (W=15) is too heavy for a live campaign
l4: no recorded synthesis for this design (L4 is not run live in campaigns)
final_text: The single spec in the queue, `low_area_control`, is finalized. I spent the full 400-eval L1 budget with `run_dse` (inner graph: map_front → add_family → map_front → stop), which produced 37 feasible non-dominated designs; the front is dominated by the `iterative` family, with the area-optimal corner at `data_width=15, n_iter=15, angle_guard=0, frac_guard=0, rounding=round` giving luts_plus_ffs=257 (166 LUTs + 91 FFs), max_abs_err=0.00081 (2^-10.27), throughput 11 MSPS — both constraints (≥1 MSPS, ≤2^-10 error) met with margin, and accuracy_bits=10.3. Extra guard bits buy accuracy up to 2^-12.3 at +12…+36 LUT+FF cost, so the min-area rule picks the 257-point. L2 was not applicable (the spec has no system scenario, so no sys_* bounds needed simulating). On the ladder, L3 `verify_rtl` and L4 `synthesize` returned no recorded rows for this design (a fresh W=15 exhaustive run is too heavy for a live campaign), and L5 `back_annotate` returned `no_measured_data` with no winner-change flag, so `reexplore` was correctly not triggered and the selection is unchanged; the L1 cost-model estimate (errors exact from the golden model) is the sole characterization. `finalize` recorded the selection, and the memory write was refused (memory switched off for this campaign).
